name: qa-code-quality
description: Production code quality checks: SonarQube maintainability gates, Lizard complexity limits, Madge circular dependencies, and Knip dead-code detection. A critic agent (code-quality-critic) merges the tool reports, dedupes overlapping findings, and separates fix-now items from the backlog. Production code only; test-code hygiene lives in qa-test-review.
